integrity: Analytical proof and standalone finite exact checker are supplied. The original map, invariant plane, Jacobian and fixed-point multipliers are credited to prior literature. Neither independent audit nor historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The null-basin theorem concerns nonempty compact invariant diagonal sets excluding the origin and nonzero a,b. The ergodic exponent formula excludes measures charging the derivative switching line. Sharpness is existence-based in b, not a full phase diagram. No global basin classification for sets containing the origin is given.
title: A sharp null-basin barrier for diagonal invariant sets in the three-dimensional Lozi map
